description: Forward geocode a single address to latitude/longitude with accuracy score and type. Optionally append data fields (congressional district, census/FIPS, timezone, ACS demographics, etc.). Example: geocodio_geocode({ q: "1109 N Highland St, Arlington VA", fields: "cd,census,timezone", _apiKey: "your-key" })

fields.description: Optional comma-separated data appends, e.g. "cd,census,timezone". Common: cd (congressional district), stateleg (state legislative districts), school (school districts), census, acs-demographics, acs-economics, acs-families, acs-housing, acs-social, zip4, timezone, riding/provriding/statcan (Canada), uk-westminster/uk-devolved/uk-local (UK).

limit.description: Maximum number of matched results to return (optional).

q.description: Full address to geocode, e.g. "1109 N Highland St, Arlington VA 22201" or "Chicago, IL".

name: geocodio_geocode
